    - **Simkin**, cobbler of this lane for fifty years. My wife [Winifred](../npcs/winifred.md) tells the stories on the step. I mend the shoes and correct her.
    - Our girl [Gytha](../npcs/gytha.md) runs the washing yard round the corner. Her boy wears his soles out in places no street can. I say nothing. I stitch.
    - Too much of it. More adventurers every season, and they come back with soles split on stone and burned on things they won't name.
    - I could use an apprentice with good hands and some patience. Not that anybody listens to an old man.
    - Came in on a boot this year. A scorch the shape of a footprint. I don't know what made it, and I kept it anyway. Don't ask me why.
    - Off you go. And walk on the whole foot, not the heel.
